checked_how: GitHub releases and security-advisories APIs for sebadob/rauthy and authzed/spicedb; registry manifests read by digest from ghcr.io, registry-1.docker.io and public.ecr.aws

rauthy.image_source_note: The pinned ablative commit is the upstream v0.36.2 tag commit itself (docs/design/identity/RAUTHY-BASELINE.md), so upstream's published v0.36.2 image is built from the pinned source. When ablative diverges from the tag (row 03), a fork-built image pinned by digest replaces it.
rauthy.accepted_exception: IDENTITY-001-UPSTREAM-AUTH-STATE: v0.36.2 lacks upstream hardening #1696 and #1728. Accepted for isolated development installs with test identities in rows 02 to 05 only (Waffles, door time 15:36:25); it binds real sign-in and install in rows 06 and 07 through IDENTITY-002.

spicedb.advisories: Every published advisory is patched at or before v1.56.2; the latest, GHSA-jf7w-wx43-32gc (affected >= v1.54.0, < v1.56.2), is patched in this release.

postgres.image_source_note: The Docker Official Image, pulled through its ECR Public mirror, whose index digest is identical to docker.io/library/postgres:17.11-bookworm. PostgreSQL 17 is a supported major release; 17.11 is its latest minor at the check.
